# No eval() call in Python

## Description

Reports a structural `eval(...)` call anywhere in a Python file, via `ast.v1`.

## Rationale

`eval()` on unsanitized input is a common injection vector; a structural match finds a real call and does not fire on the text `eval(` inside a string or comment.

## Limitations

- Only matches a direct `eval(...)` call; an aliased or indirectly obtained reference to `eval` is not recognized.
- Does not evaluate whether the argument is actually attacker-controlled.
